name: Zairza
description: The premier technical society of OUTR, fostering innovation in robotics, software development, and UI/UX design through hands-on projects, workshops, and fests.

name: Spectrum
description: A leading technical club focusing on Hardware (VLSI, Embedded Systems, PCB Design), Software (Web/App, Machine Learning), and UI/UX Design.

name: Zigbee
description: A dynamic student developers' club driving open-source culture, web and mobile app development, competitive coding, and career prep workshops, currently maintained by the MCA and CS departments.

name: SAE / Blue Jay Racing
description: The official student chapter of SAE at OUTR. Its collegiate team, Blue Jay Racing, designs, fabricates, and races off-road BAJA vehicles in national events.

name: ASME OUTR Chapter
description: The student section of the American Society of Mechanical Engineers, empowering students through design projects, engineering seminars, and fabrication workshops.

name: Aerospace Club
description: Established in 2019, the club is a hub for aerodynamics, UAV systems, quadcopters, model rocketry, and satellite design simulations.

name: ISTE Students' Chapter
description: A national-level student chapter promoting curriculum-linked technical events, professional skill webinars, and coding competitions.

name: Energy Club
description: Promotes awareness and research in sustainable energy, green tech solutions, environment conservation, and clean power grids.

name: EWB OUTR Chapter
description: The Engineers Without Borders chapter, applying engineering principles to deliver sanitation, clean water, and solar solutions to rural communities.

name: Biozo
description: The official Biotechnology club, providing deep exposure to bio-informatics, genetic engineering, microbiology, and environmental sciences.

name: CIVICON
description: The departmental club of Civil Engineering, organizing bridge fabrication contests, structural analysis workshops, and CAD design drills.

name: CETADEL
description: The official literary and debating society of OUTR, uniting creative writers, book lovers, and quizzers. It publishes the official campus e-magazine, The Letterman.

name: Amuza
description: The official dramatics and filmmaking society of OUTR, showcasing acting talent through street plays (nukkad naataks), stage skits, and short films.

name: Arpeggio
description: The official musical society of OUTR, hosting jamming sessions, open mics, acoustic nights, and forming ensembles for university festivals.

name: Photofactory
description: The official photography and digital design society, training students in videography, photojournalism, visual layout, and capturing university events.

name: TDA (The Dance Authority)
description: The official dance association of OUTR, bringing energy and rhythm to campus fests through classical, hip-hop, contemporary, and fusion dance acts.

name: Spinneret
description: The official Textile Engineering club, displaying sustainable fiber engineering, fabric testing models, apparel designing, and campus fashion shows.

name: NSS OUTR
description: The university's National Service Scheme wing, conducting Swachh Bharat cleanliness drives, village surveys, blood donation camps, and leadership training camps.
